note: vespera_macro: an internally tagged newtype over an externally tagged enum documents its unit variants as {"A": null} keys next to the tag (a unit-only inner enum no longer fails to compile), and a non-object inline payload (Uuid, NaiveDate) is a compile error instead of vanishing behind a bare discriminator. A map payload's length bounds count the tag. The request view of a mixed externally tagged enum accepts a unit variant's {"Name": null} map form. A tuple position with skip_serializing_if is optional in the response view and later positions may shift into its slot. status = N re-keys only the inferred success, never an explicit responses = [(200, T)], and 1xx / 3xx declared statuses are not labelled Error response. Every garde length rule (one per mode) applies, inner(..) reaches Box<[T]> and &[T], and a pattern using Rust-only regex syntax is skipped. Doc comments drop their common indentation like rustdoc. A SeaORM relation $ref names a known component ({Module} / {Module}Schema) or documents any value. Recursive generic instance names escape the base name. Path<TupleStruct> types each segment positionally. A Result nested in a response is axum's Ok body plus another error response. crate:: / super:: return aliases resolve in the crate root / parent module, and use anyhow; makes anyhow::Result external.
